content: 1. Nelfinavir increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of linagliptin by inhibiting hepatic and intestinal CYP3A4 enzyme metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 2. Nelfinavir reduces the efficacy of liraglutide through mechanisms related to insulin resistance, as reported with protease inhibitors. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 3. Lomitapide increases nelfinavir levels by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Therapy modification or close monitoring is recommended. Consider reducing the nelfinavir dose when used concomitantly with lomitapide. 4. Nelfinavir increases lopinavir levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 5. Nelfinavir increases loratadine levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism, while loratadine also increases nelfinavir levels via P-glycoprotein inhibition. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 6. Nelfinavir increases lumacaftor/ivacaftor levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification or close monitoring is recommended. Due to lumacaftor's induction of CYP3A, the net exposure of ivacaftor at steady state is not expected to exceed monotherapy levels. No dose adjustment is necessary when initiating CYP3A inhibitors in patients on lumacaftor/ivacaftor. However, when starting lumacaftor/ivacaftor in patients on strong CYP3A inhibitors, reduce the dose to one tablet daily for the first week to allow for steady-state induction effects, then resume the recommended daily dose. 7. Nelfinavir increases lumateperone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification or close monitoring is recommended. Limit lumateperone to 5 mg/day when coadministered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 8. Nelfinavir increases lumefantrine levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism, while lumefantrine decreases nelfinavir levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 9. Nelfinavir increases maraviroc levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Reduce maraviroc dose to 150 mg twice daily when coadministered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 10. Marijuana increases nelfinavir levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism, and nelfinavir increases marijuana levels similarly. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 11. Nelfinavir increases mavacamten levels or effects by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism. Therapy modification or close monitoring is recommended. Initiation of weak CYP2C19 inhibitors may require a reduced mavacamten dose. 12. Nelfinavir increases mavorixafor levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism and P-glycoprotein. Therapy modification or close monitoring is recommended. Mavorixafor also increases nelfinavir levels via P-glycoprotein inhibition. Caution is advised when coadministering mavorixafor with sensitive P-glycoprotein substrates, as minimal changes in substrate concentration may lead to serious adverse effects. 13. Nelfinavir increases meperidine levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely due to the potential for increased toxicity. 14. Nelfinavir increases mestranol levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism but also decreases mestranol levels by increasing its metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely, as this may result in contraceptive failure. 15. Nelfinavir reduces metformin efficacy through mechanisms related to insulin resistance, as reported with protease inhibitors. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 16. Nelfinavir increases methadone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 17. Nelfinavir increases methylprednisolone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 18. Metronidazole increases nelfinavir levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 19. Miconazole vaginal increases nelfinavir levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 20. Nelfinavir increases midazolam levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 21. Nelfinavir and mifepristone mutually increase each other's levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 22. Nelfinavir reduces miglitol efficacy through mechanisms related to insulin resistance, as reported with protease inhibitors. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 23. Nelfinavir and mipomersen may mutually increase each other's toxicity due to their potential to elevate hepatic enzymes. Monitor liver function tests (LFTs) and exercise caution. 24. Nelfinavir increases mirtazapine levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely due to the potential for increased toxicity. 25. Mitotane decreases nelfinavir levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Mitotane is a strong inducer of CYP3A4; monitor for possible dosage adjustments when coadministered with CYP3A4 substrates. 26. Nelfinavir increases modafinil levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 27. Nelfinavir increases mometasone (inhaled) levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely due to the potential for increased toxicity, including the risk of Cushing's syndrome or adrenal suppression. 28. Nelfinavir increases mometasone (intranasal) levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 29. Nafcillin decreases nelfinavir levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 30. Nelfinavir increases naldemedine levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism and P-glycoprotein. Exercise caution and monitor closely for potential adverse effects. 31. Nelfinavir reduces nateglinide efficacy through mechanisms related to insulin resistance, as reported with protease inhibitors. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 32. Nefazodone increases nelfinavir levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism and P-glycoprotein. Nelfinavir also increases nefazodone levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 33. Nelfinavir increases netupitant/palonosetron levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. No dosage adjustment is required for netupitant, which is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4. 34. Nevirapine decreases nelfinavir levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Both drugs increase the risk of immune reconstitution syndrome. Nelfinavir also increases nevirapine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 35. Nelfinavir increases nicardipine levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism, while nicardipine increases nelfinavir levels via P-glycoprotein inhibition. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 36. Nelfinavir increases nifedipine levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Consider initiating nifedipine at the lowest available dose when coadministered with nelfinavir. Nifedipine also decreases nelfinavir levels via P-glycoprotein. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 37. Nelfinavir increases nilotinib levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Nilotinib also increases nelfinavir levels via CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein inhibition. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 38. Nelfinavir increases nintedanib levels via P-glycoprotein inhibition. Therapy modification or close monitoring is recommended. If adverse effects occur, management may require dose reduction, therapy interruption, or discontinuation. 39. Nirmatrelvir increases nelfinavir levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Patients on ritonaviror cobicistat-containing HIV regimens should continue their treatment as indicated. Monitor for increased adverse events with concomitant use. 40. Nelfinavir increases nisoldipine levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 41. Nizatidine decreases nelfinavir levels by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 42. Nelfinavir increases norethindrone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 43. Nelfinavir increases norgestrel levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase systemic norgestrel concentrations, raising the risk of adverse effects. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 44. Nelfinavir increases oliceridine levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification or close monitoring is recommended. If concomitant use is necessary, less frequent oliceridine dosing may be required. Monitor closely for respiratory depression and sedation, and adjust subsequent doses accordingly. If the inhibitor is discontinued, consider increasing oliceridine dosage until stable drug effects are achieved. Monitor for signs of opioid withdrawal. 45. Nelfinavir increases ombitasvir/paritaprevir/ritonavir levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 46. Nelfinavir increases ombitasvir/paritaprevir/ritonavir and dasabuvir (DSC) levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 47. Nelfinavir increases ondansetron levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. CYP450 inhibitors may decrease ondansetron clearance. However, no dosage adjustment for ondansetron is recommended. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 48. Orlistat decreases nelfinavir levels by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Loss of virological control has been reported in HIV-infected patients taking orlistat concomitantly. The exact mechanism is unclear but may involve a drug-drug interaction that inhibits systemic absorption of the antiretroviral drug. Monitor HIV RNA levels frequently, and if increased viral load is confirmed, discontinue orlistat. 49. Nelfinavir increases osilodrostat levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification or close monitoring is recommended. Reduce the osilodrostat dose by half when coadministered with a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor. 50. Nelfinavir increases ospemifene levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 51. Oxcarbazepine decreases nelfinavir levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 52. Nelfinavir increases panobinostat levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification or close monitoring is recommended. Reduce the panobinostat starting dose to 10 mg if coadministered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 53. Nelfinavir increases paricalcitol levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely due to the potential for increased toxicity. 54. Pentobarbital decreases nelfinavir levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 55. Nelfinavir increases perampanel levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 56. Phenobarbital decreases nelfinavir levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism and P-glycoprotein. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 57. Phenytoin decreases nelfinavir levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism and P-glycoprotein. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 58. Nelfinavir increases pitavastatin toxicity through mechanisms involving OATP1B1 inhibition, which may increase the risk of myopathy. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 59. Nelfinavir increases polatuzumab vedotin levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Polatuzumab undergoes catabolism to small peptides, amino acids, monomethyl auristatin E (MMAE), and unconjugated MMAE-related catabolites. MMAE is a CYP3A4 substrate. Coadministration with a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor may increase unconjugated MMAE AUC, potentially increasing polatuzumab vedotin toxicities. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 60. Ponatinib increases nelfinavir levels via P-glycoprotein inhibition. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 61. Posaconazole increases nelfinavir levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely.
